answer: Resolved in d-vocab: `project` and `id` required, `state` interpreted but with only `blocked` carrying an opinion, everything else freeform and uninterpreted. The label channel is a tag set, not a metadata record: values are single tokens [a-zA-Z0-9-_.], with no authors, timestamps or prose. Residual question moved to q-state.
body: The vocabulary is now the only schema in the system, so it is the most consequential remaining decision.
